### NotificationStore

File: `src/app/core/notifications/notification-store.ts`
providedIn: `root`

Description: Notifications persistantes de l'utilisateur connecté. Chargées à l'ouverture de session et vidées à sa fermeture ; les modifications sont appliquées immédiatement à l'écran puis envoyées au serveur. En cas d'échec, la liste est rechargée.

Properties:
- `_items: unknown = linkedSignal<readonly AppNotification[]>(() => this.remote.hasValue() ? this.remote.value() : [], )`
- `api: unknown = inject(NotificationApi)`
- `auth: unknown = inject(AuthService)`
- `error: unknown = this.remote.error`
- `isLoading: unknown = this.remote.isLoading`
- `items: unknown = this._items.asReadonly()`
- `remote: unknown = rxResource({ params: () => this.auth.user()?.id, stream: () => this.api.list(), })`
- `unreadCount: unknown = computed(() => this._items().filter((n) => n.readAt === null).length)`

Methods:
- `add(notification: NewNotification): void`
- `markAllAsRead(): void`
- `markAsRead(id: string): void`
- `reload(): void`
- `remove(id: string): void`
- `sync(request: Observable<T>, onSuccess: function = () => undefined): void`

## Public type aliases

- `type ApiPath = string | number | unknown` — Segments de chemin relatifs à baseUrl , encodés individuellement.
- `type ApiQuery = Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>>` — Paramètres de requête ; null , undefined et chaîne vide sont ignorés.
- `type AppNotification = Readonly<z.infer<typeof notificationSchema>>`
- `type AuthSession = z.infer<typeof authSessionSchema>`
- `type AuthUser = z.infer<typeof authUserSchema>`
- `type LoginResponse = z.infer<typeof loginResponseSchema>`
- `type NewNotification = Pick<AppNotification | "level" | "title" | "message" | "action">`
- `type NotificationLevel = z.infer<typeof notificationLevelSchema>`
- `type ProductChanges = z.infer<typeof productChangesSchema>`
- `type ProductSchema = z.infer<typeof productSchema>`
- `type SortOrder = "asc" | "desc"`
- `type Status = "all" | "unread" | "read"`
